name: Takeda Kayoko
source:
The young proprietress of the long-established hot spring ryokan chosen as the destination for this trip.  

She first met [url=https://vndb.org/c169626]Shouta[/url] by chance when she visited his town for a national hotel industry training seminar before the trip.  
She leads an extremely busy life every day, and on top of that, things aren’t going well with her husband, causing both her mind and body to be exhausted.  

She is a natural leader who handles everything flawlessly and is relied upon by everyone around her. However, deep down, she strongly wishes to be spoiled and pampered by someone.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1368656/]Getchu[/url]]
